	[Enum.PoseEasingDirection.Out]   = Enum.EasingDirection.Out,
	[Enum.PoseEasingDirection.InOut] = Enum.EasingDirection.InOut,
}

local function PlayKeyframeSequence(Model, KeyframeSequence, SpeedMult)
	SpeedMult = SpeedMult or 1
	local keyframes = {}
	for _, kf in ipairs(KeyframeSequence:GetKeyframes()) do
		table.insert(keyframes, {Time = kf.Time, KF = kf})
	end
	table.sort(keyframes, function(a, b) return a.Time < b.Time end)
	if #keyframes == 0 then return nil end

	local jointData = {}
	local motorMap, boneMap = {}, {}

	local function ResolveJoint(pose)
		local name = pose.Name
		if motorMap[name] then return motorMap[name], "Motor6D" end
		if boneMap[name] then return boneMap[name], "Bone" end
		for _, v in ipairs(Model:GetDescendants()) do
			if v:IsA("Motor6D") and v.Part1 and v.Part1.Name == name then
				motorMap[name] = v
				return v, "Motor6D"
			elseif v:IsA("Bone") and v.Name == name then
				boneMap[name] = v
				return v, "Bone"
			end
		end
		return nil, nil
	end

	for _, entry in ipairs(keyframes) do
		for _, pose in ipairs(entry.KF:GetDescendants()) do
			if pose:IsA("Pose") and pose.Weight > 0 then
				local joint, jtype = ResolveJoint(pose)
				if joint then
					if not jointData[pose.Name] then jointData[pose.Name] = {} end
					table.insert(jointData[pose.Name], {
						time = entry.Time,
						cframe = pose.CFrame,
						style = pose.EasingStyle,
						dir = pose.EasingDirection,
						joint = joint,
						jtype = jtype
					})
				end
			end
		end
	end

	local totalLength = keyframes[#keyframes].Time / SpeedMult
	local isPlaying = true
	local startTime = os.clock()
	local connection

	connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		if not isPlaying or not Model or not Model.Parent then
			if connection then connection:Disconnect() end
			return
		end
		local elapsed = (os.clock() - startTime) * SpeedMult
		local timePos = elapsed % totalLength

		for _, poses in pairs(jointData) do
			if #poses < 1 then continue end
			local lastPose, nextPose = poses[1], poses[1]
			for i = 1, #poses - 1 do
				if timePos >= poses[i].time and timePos < poses[i + 1].time then
					lastPose = poses[i]
					nextPose = poses[i + 1]
					break
				end
			end
			if timePos >= poses[#poses].time then
				lastPose = poses[#poses]
				nextPose = poses[#poses]
			end

			local alpha = 0
			if nextPose.time > lastPose.time then
				alpha = (timePos - lastPose.time) / (nextPose.time - lastPose.time)
			end
			local style = EasingStyleMap[nextPose.style] or Enum.EasingStyle.Linear
			local dir = EasingDirectionMap[nextPose.dir] or Enum.EasingDirection.InOut
			local eased = TweenService:GetValue(alpha, style, dir)
			lastPose.joint.Transform = lastPose.cframe:Lerp(nextPose.cframe, eased)
		end
	end)

	return {
		Length = totalLength,
		Stop = function()
			isPlaying = false
			if connection then connection:Disconnect() end
		end,
		Play = function()
			startTime = os.clock()
		end
	}
end

local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos

local function UpdateDrag(input)
    local delta = input.Position - dragStart
    local targetPos = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
    TweenService:Create(MainFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.12, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Position = targetPos}):Play()
end

Header.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = MainFrame.Position
        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    end
end)

Header.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragInput = input
    end
end)

end)

local function IsVisible(targetPart)
    if not ESP_SETTINGS.WallCheckEnabled then return true end
    if not targetPart or not LocalPlayer.Character then return false end

    local origin = Camera.CFrame.Position
    local destination = targetPart.Position
    local direction = destination - origin

    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterType = RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {LocalPlayer.Character, targetPart.Parent}
    params.IgnoreWater = true

    local result = workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, params)
    return result == nil
end

local orbitAngle = 0

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(deltaTime)
    if ESP_SETTINGS.TargetUsername ~= "" then
        local targetPlayer = nil
        for _, plr in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if string.lower(plr.Name) == ESP_SETTINGS.TargetUsername then
                targetPlayer = plr
                break
            end
        end

        if targetPlayer and targetPlayer.Character then
            local targetHead = targetPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
            local targetRoot = targetPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

            if targetRoot and targetHead then
                local visible = IsVisible(targetHead)

                -- 1. Orbit Logic
                if ESP_SETTINGS.OrbitEnabled then
                    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
                    local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

                    if myRoot then
                        orbitAngle = orbitAngle + (ESP_SETTINGS.OrbitSpeed * deltaTime)
                        local offsetX = math.cos(orbitAngle) * ESP_SETTINGS.OrbitDistance
                        local offsetZ = math.sin(orbitAngle) * ESP_SETTINGS.OrbitDistance
                        local newPos = targetRoot.Position + Vector3.new(offsetX, 0, offsetZ)
                        myRoot.CFrame = CFrame.new(newPos, targetRoot.Position)
                    end
                end

                -- 2. Teleport Logic
                if ESP_SETTINGS.TeleportEnabled and visible then
                    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
                    local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

                    if myRoot then
                        myRoot.CFrame = targetRoot.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 3)
                    end
                end
            end
        end

end)

local function ConnectJoints(p1, p2, line, color)
    if not (p1 and p2) then line.Visible = false return end
    local pos1, vis1 = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(p1.Position)
    local pos2, vis2 = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(p2.Position)

    if vis1 and vis2 then
        local startVec = Vector2.new(pos1.X, pos1.Y)
        local endVec = Vector2.new(pos2.X, pos2.Y)
        local distance = (startVec - endVec).Magnitude
        local center = (startVec + endVec) / 2
        local angle = math.atan2(endVec.Y - startVec.Y, endVec.X - startVec.X)

        line.Size = UDim2.new(0, distance, 0, 1.5)
        line.Position = UDim2.new(0, center.X, 0, center.Y)
        line.Rotation = math.deg(angle)
        line.BackgroundColor3 = color
        line.Visible = true
    else
        line.Visible = false
    end
end

                if ESP_SETTINGS.Distance then textFormat = textFormat .. "[" .. hp .. " HP] • " .. dist .. "m\n" end

                data.Billboard.Enabled = ESP_SETTINGS.Names or ESP_SETTINGS.Distance or ESP_SETTINGS.Inventory

                if ESP_SETTINGS.Skeleton then
                    local R6 = char:FindFirstChild("Torso") ~= nil
                    if R6 then

                        ConnectJoints(char:FindFirstChild("Torso"), char:FindFirstChild("Left Arm"), data.Lines[2], activeColor)
                        ConnectJoints(char:FindFirstChild("Torso"), char:FindFirstChild("Right Arm"), data.Lines[3], activeColor)
                        ConnectJoints(char:FindFirstChild("Torso"), char:FindFirstChild("Left Leg"), data.Lines[4], activeColor)
                        ConnectJoints(char:FindFirstChild("Torso"), char:FindFirstChild("Right Leg"), data.Lines[5], activeColor)
                        for i = 6, 12 do data.Lines[i].Visible = false end
                    else
                        ConnectJoints(head, char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso"), data.Lines[1], activeColor)
                        ConnectJoints(char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso"), char:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso"), data.Lines[2], activeColor)
                        ConnectJoints(char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso"), char:FindFirstChild("LeftUpperArm"), data.Lines[3], activeColor)
                        ConnectJoints(char:FindFirstChild("LeftUpperArm"), char:FindFirstChild("LeftLowerArm"), data.Lines[4], activeColor)
                        ConnectJoints(char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso"), char:FindFirstChild("RightUpperArm"), data.Lines[5], activeColor)
                        ConnectJoints(char:FindFirstChild("RightUpperArm"), char:FindFirstChild("RightLowerArm"), data.Lines[6], activeColor)
                        ConnectJoints(char:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso"), char:FindFirstChild("LeftUpperLeg"), data.Lines[7], activeColor)
                        ConnectJoints(char:FindFirstChild("LeftUpperLeg"), char:FindFirstChild("LeftLowerLeg"), data.Lines[8], activeColor)
                        ConnectJoints(char:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso"), char:FindFirstChild("RightUpperLeg"), data.Lines[9], activeColor)
                        ConnectJoints(char:FindFirstChild("RightUpperLeg"), char:FindFirstChild("RightLowerLeg"), data.Lines[10], activeColor)
                        for i = 11, 12 do data.Lines[i].Visible = false end
                    end
                else
                    for _, line in pairs(data.Lines) do line.Visible = false end
                end
            else
                data.Highlight.Enabled = false
                data.Billboard.Enabled = false
                for _, line in pairs(data.Lines) do line.Visible = false end
            end
        else
            data.Highlight.Enabled = false
            data.Billboard.Enabled = false
            for _, line in pairs(data.Lines) do line.Visible = false end
        end
    end

    for item, data in pairs(Item_Cache) do
        if item and item.Parent and data.Part and ESP_SETTINGS.Enabled and ESP_SETTINGS.DroppedItems then

                data.Billboard.Enabled = true
            else

            end
        else
            if data.Billboard then data.Billboard.Enabled = false end
        end
    end
end)

--==================================================
-- FLY
-- V2
--==================================================

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

--==================================================
-- CONFIGURACIÓN
--==================================================

local SPEED = 60

local DRAG_DISTANCE = 8

--==================================================
-- VARIABLES
--==================================================

local flying = false

local bodyVelocity
local bodyGyro
local flyConnection

-- Variables del arrastre
local dragging = false
local pressed = false
local dragInput = nil
local dragStart
local startPosition
local dragStarted = false

--==================================================
-- CREAR GUI
--==================================================

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "FlyGui"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

--==================================================
-- BOTÓN FLY
--==================================================

local flyButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
flyButton.Name = "FlyButton"

flyButton.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(90, 50)

flyButton.Position = UDim2.new(
	1,
	-110,
	1,
	-160
)

flyButton.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
flyButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 35)

flyButton.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
flyButton.TextScaled = true
flyButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
flyButton.Text = "FLY"

flyButton.AutoButtonColor = true
flyButton.Parent = gui

--==================================================
-- BORDE REDONDEADO
--==================================================

local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
corner.Parent = flyButton

--==================================================
-- INICIAR VUELO
--==================================================

local function startFly()

	if flying then
		return
	end

	local character = player.Character

	if not character then
		return
	end

	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	if not humanoid or not root then
		return
	end

	flying = true

	humanoid.PlatformStand = true

	--==================================================
	-- VELOCIDAD
	--==================================================

	bodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")

	bodyVelocity.Name = "FlyVelocity"

	bodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(
		math.huge,
		math.huge,
		math.huge
	)

	bodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.zero
	bodyVelocity.Parent = root

	--==================================================
	-- ORIENTACIÓN
	--==================================================

	bodyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")

	bodyGyro.Name = "FlyGyro"

	bodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(
		math.huge,
		math.huge,
		math.huge
	)

	bodyGyro.P = 9000
	bodyGyro.D = 500

	bodyGyro.CFrame = camera.CFrame
	bodyGyro.Parent = root

	--==================================================
	-- ACTUALIZAR VUELO
	--==================================================

	flyConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()

		if not flying then
			return
		end

		if not root.Parent then
			return
		end

		local direction = Vector3.zero

		--==================================================
		-- JOYSTICK MÓVIL
		--==================================================

		local moveDirection = humanoid.MoveDirection

		if moveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then

			local cameraLook = camera.CFrame.LookVector
			local cameraRight = camera.CFrame.RightVector

			local flatLook = Vector3.new(
				cameraLook.X,
				0,
				cameraLook.Z
			)

			if flatLook.Magnitude > 0 then
				flatLook = flatLook.Unit
			end

			local flatRight = Vector3.new(
				cameraRight.X,
				0,
				cameraRight.Z
			)

			if flatRight.Magnitude > 0 then
				flatRight = flatRight.Unit
			end

			local forwardAmount = moveDirection:Dot(flatLook)
			local rightAmount = moveDirection:Dot(flatRight)

			direction =
				cameraLook * forwardAmount
				+
				flatRight * rightAmount
		end

		--==================================================
		-- CONTROLES PC
		--==================================================

		-- IMPORTANTE:
		-- Si estamos escribiendo en el chat o en otro TextBox,
		-- NO se leen las teclas del teclado.

		if not UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then

			if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then
				direction += camera.CFrame.LookVector
			end

			if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then
				direction -= camera.CFrame.LookVector
			end

			if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then
				direction -= camera.CFrame.RightVector
			end

			if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then
				direction += camera.CFrame.RightVector
			end

			--==================================================
			-- SUBIR / BAJAR
			--==================================================

			if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
				direction += Vector3.yAxis
			end

			if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then
				direction -= Vector3.yAxis
			end

		end

		--==================================================
		-- APLICAR MOVIMIENTO
		--==================================================

		if direction.Magnitude > 0 then
			direction = direction.Unit * SPEED
		else
			direction = Vector3.zero
		end

		bodyVelocity.Velocity = direction

		-- El personaje mira hacia donde apunta la cámara
		bodyGyro.CFrame = camera.CFrame

	end)

	flyButton.Text = "STOP"

end

--==================================================
-- DETENER VUELO
--==================================================

local function stopFly()

	if not flying then
		return
	end

	flying = false

	-- Detener actualización
	if flyConnection then
		flyConnection:Disconnect()
		flyConnection = nil
	end

	-- Eliminar velocidad
	if bodyVelocity then
		bodyVelocity:Destroy()
		bodyVelocity = nil
	end

	-- Eliminar orientación
	if bodyGyro then
		bodyGyro:Destroy()
		bodyGyro = nil
	end

	-- Recuperar movimiento normal
	local character = player.Character

	if character then

		local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

		if humanoid then
			humanoid.PlatformStand = false
		end

	end

	flyButton.Text = "FLY"

end

--==================================================
-- ACTIVAR / DESACTIVAR
--==================================================

local function toggleFly()

	if flying then
		stopFly()
	else
		startFly()
	end

end

--==================================================
-- DETECTAR CLIC / TOQUE
--==================================================

flyButton.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)

	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		pressed = true
		dragging = false
		dragStarted = false

		dragStart = input.Position
		startPosition = flyButton.Position

		dragInput = input

	end

end)

--==================================================
-- DETECTAR MOVIMIENTO
--==================================================

flyButton.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)

	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		dragInput = input

	end

end)

--==================================================
-- FINALIZAR CLIC / TOQUE
--==================================================

flyButton.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)

	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		-- Si NO se arrastró, es un toque normal.
		if pressed and not dragStarted then
			toggleFly()
		end

		pressed = false
		dragging = false
		dragStarted = false
		dragInput = nil

	end

end)

--==================================================
-- ACTUALIZAR ARRASTRE
--==================================================

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)

	if not pressed then
		return
	end

	if input ~= dragInput then
		return
	end

	local delta = input.Position - dragStart

	-- Comprobar si se movió suficiente
	if delta.Magnitude >= DRAG_DISTANCE then
		dragStarted = true
		dragging = true
	end

	if dragging then

		flyButton.Position = UDim2.new(
			startPosition.X.Scale,
			startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,

			startPosition.Y.Scale,
			startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
		)

	end

end)

--==================================================
-- TECLA E EN PC
--==================================================

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)

	-- No activar Fly mientras se escribe
	if UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then
		return
	end

	-- Roblox ya está usando esta entrada
	if processed then
		return
	end

	-- E activa/desactiva Fly
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.E then
		toggleFly()
	end

end)

--==================================================
-- SI EL PERSONAJE APARECE DE NUEVO
--==================================================

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)

	-- Apagar vuelo anterior
	stopFly()

	local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

	humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
		stopFly()
	end)

end)

-- auto-gym script for shigaku, basically just presses q/e when it has to
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local VIM = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local enabled = true
local RETRY_DELAY = 0.35 -- re-press if a box stays red this long
local keys = { Q = Enum.KeyCode.Q, E = Enum.KeyCode.E }
local wasRed = { Q = false, E = false }
local lastPress = { Q = 0, E = 0 }
local boxes = { Q = nil, E = nil }

local function isRed(c)
    return c.R > 0.6 and c.G < 0.4 and c.B < 0.4
end

local function isLetter(d, letter)
    if not d:IsA("GuiObject") then return false end
    if (d:IsA("TextLabel") or d:IsA("TextButton")) then
        local t = d.Text:gsub("%s", ""):upper()
        if t == letter then return true end
    end
    return d.Name:upper() == letter
end

local function visibleChain(d)
    local o = d
    while o and o ~= playerGui do
        if o:IsA("GuiObject") and not o.Visible then return false end
        if o:IsA("ScreenGui") and not o.Enabled then return false end
        o = o.Parent
    end
    return o == playerGui
end

-- find a visible Q, then a visible E inside the same container
local function locate()
    for _, q in ipairs(playerGui:GetDescendants()) do
        if isLetter(q, "Q") and visibleChain(q) then
            local anc = q.Parent
            for _ = 1, 6 do
                if not anc or anc == playerGui then break end
                for _, d in ipairs(anc:GetDescendants()) do
                    if d ~= q and isLetter(d, "E") and visibleChain(d) then
                        boxes.Q, boxes.E = q, d
                        return
                    end
                end
                anc = anc.Parent
            end
        end
    end
    boxes.Q, boxes.E = nil, nil
end

local function colorRed(o)
    if o:IsA("GuiObject") and o.BackgroundTransparency < 1 and isRed(o.BackgroundColor3) then
        return true
    end
    if (o:IsA("ImageLabel") or o:IsA("ImageButton")) and isRed(o.ImageColor3) then
        return true
    end
    return false
end

local function boxIsRed(obj)
    if not obj or not obj.Parent then return false end
    if colorRed(obj) then return true end
    local p = obj.Parent
    for _ = 1, 2 do
        if p and p ~= playerGui and colorRed(p) then return true end
        p = p and p.Parent
    end
    for _, c in ipairs(obj:GetChildren()) do
        if colorRed(c) then return true end
    end
    return false
end

local function press(letter, obj)
    lastPress[letter] = tick()
    if obj and obj:IsA("GuiButton") and getconnections then
        for _, c in ipairs(getconnections(obj.MouseButton1Click)) do pcall(c.Fire, c) end
        for _, c in ipairs(getconnections(obj.Activated)) do pcall(c.Fire, c) end
    end
    VIM:SendKeyEvent(true, keys[letter], false, game)
    task.wait(0.05)
    VIM:SendKeyEvent(false, keys[letter], false, game)
end

-- toggle button + status
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "AutoQE"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = (gethui and gethui()) or game:GetService("CoreGui")

local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 150, 0, 44)
btn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0.5, 0)
btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 160, 70)
btn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
btn.TextSize = 12
btn.Text = "Auto QE: ON"
btn.Active = true
btn.Draggable = true
btn.Parent = gui
Instance.new("UICorner", btn)

btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    enabled = not enabled
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = enabled and Color3.fromRGB(40, 160, 70) or Color3.fromRGB(170, 50, 50)
end)

local lastScan = 0
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if not enabled then btn.Text = "Auto QE: OFF" return end

    -- rescan if boxes are missing OR no longer visible (hidden UI counts as gone)
    local stale = not boxes.Q or not boxes.E
        or not boxes.Q.Parent or not boxes.E.Parent
        or not visibleChain(boxes.Q) or not visibleChain(boxes.E)
    if stale and tick() - lastScan > 0.25 then
        lastScan = tick()
        locate()
        wasRed.Q, wasRed.E = false, false
    end

    local status = {}
    for letter in pairs(keys) do
        local obj = boxes[letter]
        local red = boxIsRed(obj)
        status[letter] = obj and (red and "red" or "--") or "none"
        if red and (not wasRed[letter] or tick() - lastPress[letter] > RETRY_DELAY) then
            task.spawn(press, letter, obj)
        end
        wasRed[letter] = red
    end
    btn.Text = ("Auto QE: ON\nQ:%s  E:%s"):format(status.Q, status.E)
end)
